branch_deviation.reason: the agent session is pinned to this branch; work on any other branch is not tracked. Disclosed, not silently substituted.

unit_evidence.note: Measured locally with PYTHONPATH=. python -m pytest, on a FULL (non-shallow) clone.
unit_evidence.shallow_checkout_caveat: tests/test_audit_phase_8_4_2_f.py skips one topology test when the checkout is shallow ('needs fetch-depth: 0'). actions/checkout@v4 defaults to depth 1, so the SAME suite reports one fewer passed and one skipped in CI than on a full local clone. This is the documented cause of the previously reported 851-vs-850 discrepancy; the test total is identical.

mutation_evidence.note: Each probe weakens one control in an ISOLATED COPY of the tree; the working tree is never mutated. The 3 'layered' probes are single layers of a deliberately redundant defence and are covered by combined probes that strip every layer at once.
mutation_evidence.defect_found_by_the_harness: the workspace-confinement test was passing on the filename check, so all confinement layers could be deleted unnoticed; the test was tightened and the combined probe now fails without them.

static_guard.allowed_exception: the trusted container adapter may spawn docker/podman only

live_e2e.image_digest_note: The sandbox image is built and pushed to a local registry during the run, so the digest is computed by the registry (never invented) and differs per build. The digest above is the one observed in run 37588703539.
live_e2e.uid_note: The GitHub runner's control-plane process is uid 1001 (non-root), so the sandbox reuses that identity by design. On a root control plane it would be 65532:65532 and the workspace is chowned.
live_e2e.kubernetes_note: Kubernetes is stubbed in the live driver. Kubernetes execution hardening is a separate phase and is NOT validated here.

secrets: No secret values are recorded. The credential profile is derived from credential NAMES only.
